purpose: Defines the review priority system (P1/P2/P3), the relation between priority and severity, where severity and gray-zone judgment live, and the fixed structure of review criteria files.
summary: Priority definitions: P1 rule conformance, P2 contradiction, P3 unnecessary complexity
Priority and severity are independent axes; severity only orders presentation
Severity SoT is the severity catalog of the delegated principles
Severity catalogs for document references and terminology
Exclusion rules: P2/P3 scope limits, no custom perspectives, proportionality check for fix decisions
Criteria declare no severity and no gray-zone judgment; all judgment is delegated to principles
Excluding findings based on expired ADR rejection reasons and recording the ADR number
Fixed three-section structure of review_criteria files with template
Priority order among multiple SoTs: project-specific over built-in
tasks: Deciding whether to file an issue for missing rules
Judging findings against ADR rejection reasons
title: レビュー優先度仕様
